name: taxes_by_sequence
note: AccountTax._order = 'sequence,id' (addons/account/models/account_tax.py): the tax list as the ORM orders it with company, scope, computation type and active flag (active_test off)
source_sql: SELECT id, sequence, company_id, type_tax_use, amount_type, active FROM account_tax ORDER BY sequence, id

name: repartition_lines_per_tax
note: account.tax.repartition_line_ids one2many (addons/account/models/account_tax.py) embedded as accountTax.repartitionLine: lines per tax with the invoice-document and tax-type counts; taxes without lines excluded on both sides
source_sql: SELECT tax_id, count(*) AS lines, count(*) FILTER (WHERE document_type = 'invoice') AS invoice_lines, count(*) FILTER (WHERE repartition_type = 'tax') AS tax_lines FROM account_tax_repartition_line GROUP BY tax_id ORDER BY tax_id
